description.zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en: The personal access token. Not required if you authenticate with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS).

description.zh: 合并请求局部ID，表示代码库下的第几个合并请求
description.en: The local ID of the merge request, which is its number within the repository.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The ID of the organization. You can find this ID in the URL of your organization page on Alibaba Cloud DevOps, for example: `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.

descriptions.zh: 该接口需要确保当前企业已经在使用新版MR，具体可看当前企业的合并请求页面是否已是新版本。
descriptions.en: This API is available only if your organization is using the new version of merge requests. You can verify this on the merge request page for your organization.
